system.name: RMP-SAM
system.one_liner: A single real-time model for panoptic, video instance and interactive segmentation, with a dual-adapter decoder, benchmarked on speed and accuracy.

content.variant_note: (a) image, video and prompt inputs feed one boxed model that fans out to three outputs; (b) four speed-accuracy bubble plots as result tiles
content.argues: One real-time model can segment image, video and visual-prompt inputs, and RMP-SAM gives the best speed-accuracy trade-off among the compared models across the four plotted settings.
content.subject: three input types through one boxed model to three segmentation outputs, plus four speed-accuracy bubble plots

lessons.what_to_learn: A teaser can pair a left panel that states the task as real inputs, one boxed model and real outputs lined up by row, with a right panel of identical bubble plots in which the model keeps the colour of its box, so the claim and the evidence read as one story.
lessons.suits: Unified or multi-task models whose headline is a speed-accuracy trade-off across several tasks, with photos as inputs and outputs.

evidence: We present an illustration figure in Fig. 1(a).
the best speed and accuracy trade-off on four different tasks, as shown in Fig. 1(b)
The larger dot indicates more parameters.

summary: RMP-SAM is a single real-time model for panoptic, video instance and interactive segmentation. Figure 1 is a two-part teaser split by a dashed line. Panel a) states the setting: a street-market photo, two stacked video frames and a rider photo with blue click marks go into one yellow RMP-SAM box with a rocket icon and an FPS above 30 badge, and come out as an image, a video and a prompt segmentation render, level with their inputs. Panel b) holds four speed-accuracy bubble plots (PQ, mAP, mIoU and 1-IoU against FPS) where larger dots mean more parameters, Ours is drawn in the model-box yellow, and other methods have their own colours.
summary_zh: RMP-SAM 是统一的实时分割模型。图 1 分两部分：a) 图像、视频和点击提示输入同一个黄色模型框，输出三类分割结果；b) 四张速度-精度气泡图，点越大参数越多，本文方法用黄色标出。
notes: Prior labels had stage-pipeline (fan-out) first; kept, with contribution-mosaic added for panel b). The text mentions four tasks in 1(b) while the caption says three; the figure draws four plots. The slate and salmon bubble hexes (Semantic-SAM(L), SAM(L)) are not in the digest and are left out of the palette.
